description: This Kotlin source file defines the DashboardFragment class for an Android application. The fragment displays a list of recent expenses retrieved from a local SQLite database using the SqliteExpenseRepository and presents the data with a RecyclerView using the RecentExpensesAdapter.

classes.name: DashboardFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment class responsible for displaying a dashboard with recent expense data loaded from a local SQLite database.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment and sets up the expense repository.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout from XML.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Refreshes the list of recent expenses each time the fragment resumes.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Configures the RecyclerView for displaying recent expenses.
